A1.question: Which shipping mode had the highest late rate among orders completed by 2016-07-31, and how many orders is that based on?
A1.sql: SELECT shipping_mode, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_on > sla_due_on) AS late_orders, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_on > sla_due_on)::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE NOT is_excluded AND completed_on <= %(as_of)s GROUP BY shipping_mode ORDER BY late_rate DESC, completed_orders DESC LIMIT 1

A4.question: Which state has the most open at-risk orders, and how many?
A4.sql: WITH per_state AS ( SELECT s.english_name AS state, COUNT(*) AS open_at_risk FROM orders o JOIN state_names s ON s.original_name = o.order_state WHERE NOT o.is_excluded AND o.order_date <= %(as_of)s AND o.completed_on > %(as_of)s AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_flags f WHERE f.order_id = o.order_id AND f.rule_version = 'v1' AND f.flag_date <= %(as_of)s ) GROUP BY s.english_name ) SELECT p.state, p.open_at_risk, (SELECT MAX(q.open_at_risk) FROM per_state q WHERE q.state <> p.state) AS runner_up_count FROM per_state p ORDER BY p.open_at_risk DESC, p.state LIMIT 1
